theorem walkAcc_correct (t : Tree α) (acc : List α) : walkAcc t acc = inorder t ++ acc := by
  induction t with
  | empty =>
      rfl
  | node l x r ihl ihrgoal := by
      -- Inductive hypothesis from left subtree
      -- Inductive hypothesis from right subtree
      simp [walkAcc, inorder] at *
      <;> rw [List.cons_append]
      <;> rw [ihrgoal]
      <;> rw [ihl]

      rw [ihrgoal acc]

  | empty : Tree α
  | node : Tree α → α → Tree α → Tree α

  | .empty => []
  | .node l x r => inorder l ++ x :: inorder r
def walkAcc : Tree α → List α → List α
  | .empty, acc => acc
  | .node l x r, acc => walkAcc l (x :: walkAcc r acc)

theorem walkAcc_correct (t : Tree α) (acc : List α) : walkAcc t acc = inorder t ++ acc := by
  revert acc
  induction t with
  | empty =>
      intro acc
      rfl
  | node l x r ihl ihrgoal =>
      intro acc
      unfold walkAcc
      -- Goal: walkAcc l (x :: walkAcc r acc) = (inorder l ++ x :: inorder r) ++ acc
      rw [List.cons_append]
      -- Now goal: walkAcc l (x :: walkAcc r acc) = inorder l ++ x :: inorder r ++ acc
      -- Apply IH for right subtree: walkAcc r acc = inorder r ++ acc
      calc
        walkAcc l (x :: walkAcc r acc) = walkAcc l (x :: (inorder r ++ acc)) := by
          rw [ihrgoal acc]
        _ = inorder l ++ (x :: (inorder r ++ acc)) := by
          rw [ihl (x :: (inorder r ++ acc))]
        _ = inorder l ++ x :: inorder r ++ acc := by
          simp only [List.insert_cons_append, List.append_assoc, List.append_comm]
        _ = (inorder l ++ x :: inorder r) ++ acc := by
          rw [← List.cons_append]
          rw [List.cons_append]
          rfl

  revert acc
  induction t with
  | empty =>
      intro acc
      rfl

      intro acc
      unfold walkAcc inorder
      -- After unfolding: walkAcc l (x :: walkAcc r acc) = (inorder l ++ x) :: inorder r ++ acc
      rw [← List.cons_append]
      rw [← List.cons_append]
      -- Now goal is: walkAcc l (x :: walkAcc r acc) = inorder l ++ x :: inorder r ++ acc
      calc

        _ = (inorder l ++ x) :: (inorder r ++ acc) := by simp only [List.insert_cons_append, List.append_assoc]
        _ = ((inorder l ++ x) :: inorder r) ++ acc := by rw [List.cons_append]; rfl
        _ = inorder l ++ x :: inorder r ++ acc := by rfl
        _ = (inorder l ++ x :: inorder r) ++ acc := by rfl
